market_summary: Broad USD dominance and aggressive risk-off/liquidation across Gold, EUR, GBP, and BTC during the London/NY Overlap session. All 4 assets have broken well below their respective Value Area Lows and session VWAPs, printing deep extensions outside their lower ATR-2 bands directly into session low support zones. Given the stretched nature of these moves and initial absorption wicks at multi-hour lows, disciplined risk management dictates HOLDing to avoid selling into local exhaustion bottoms.

Price testing Put Wall #2 (3869.45) and Session Low (3852.35). With heavy oversold extension directly into key Put Wall #2 and Session Low support, risk-reward for new sells is poor and no reversal structure is confirmed. HOLD.
